answer: Tie every reward to a 280-unit refundable bond and a twenty-epoch probation. Each epoch the agent must finish one random task and collect four attestations from reviewers whose recent contacts never intersect; reused proofs, duplicated phrasing, or clock-synchronized submissions freeze the bond for six epochs. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil operator locks 280 units per alias and replays twenty rounds, while a canyon of correlated traces exposes the ring, sonnet hashes flag copied text, and beacon timestamps make imitation costly.
